what_this_is: Per-fund facts that Form N-PORT does not carry: net and gross expense ratio, inception date, index, stated mandate, and the prospectus's standardised average-annual-total-return table including after-tax rows. Every figure is read from the fund's own SEC-filed summary prospectus (Form 497K) rather than from a sponsor web page, because a filing carries an accession number, a filing date and an immutable document. Read on 2026-08-12, BEFORE any fund return was downloaded.
after_tax_methodology: Item 4(b)(2)(iii) of Form N-1A. After-tax returns are computed by the fund using the HIGHEST individual federal marginal income and capital-gains tax rates in effect at the time of each distribution, and reflect NO state or local tax. They assume shares held in a taxable account; they are irrelevant to an IRA or a 401(k). They are the fund's own figures, not this repository's estimate.
why_no_threshold_uses_these: The after-tax figures were read while assembling this file, so any falsifier threshold placed on them now would be a threshold chosen after seeing the quantity. They are measured and reported and are in NO clause of Experiment 008's frozen falsifier. See parameters.clause_d_disclosure in the specification.
sponsor_page_note: The sponsor web pages for DBMF, KMLM and WisdomTree returned HTTP 403 to an automated client on 2026-08-12. The SEC-filed summary prospectus was used instead for every fund, which is the stronger source in any case.

VTI.mandate_evidence: NOT a screened product. VTI is the model-misfit pedestal: a cap-weighted total-market fund IS the market portfolio, so under a correctly specified model its alpha should be about minus its three-basis-point fee. It is resolved outside the screen so the benchmark cannot be selected by the thing being screened. Facts carried over unchanged from Experiment 002's committed product facts.
